attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Required. ID of the target <audio> element

attributes.name: data-fft-size
attributes.description: AnalyserNode FFT size (power of 2, 32-32768). Default: 256. Other values are rounded to the nearest power of two and clamped to that range

attributes.name: data-state
attributes.description: Set when the visualizer cannot hook the audio: "cross-origin" (cross-origin source without crossorigin + CORS — left unhooked so it stays audible) or "error" (Web Audio connection failed). Absent while visualizing normally
